However, with the spotlight stolen by the brand-new Mac mini and Mac Studio, Apple seemingly didn't want to be overlooked — today it also rolled out an updated version of its polishing cloth. In an era where just about everything seems to be getting pricier, the new cloth goes against the grain and has dropped in price to US$9 (down from the original US$19).

What exactly has changed about the new cloth remains unclear for now; Apple's product description for the new version is identical to the old one:

Apple first launched the polishing cloth back in October 2021, and it was practically sold out the moment it went on sale. Although the product has become something of an internet meme, it genuinely is a decent cloth for cleaning Apple devices.

You can order this 'new' cloth from Apple's website starting today, priced at US$9. I'd tell you to grab one quickly — half-jokingly, of course — but then again, I might not be entirely joking, because these things do tend to sell out in no time.

If you'd like to keep a piece of Apple history, the original polishing cloth is still available on Amazon for US$19.
